title: Lirael
dek: A recurring guide whose presence can point travelers onward without promising to keep them safe.

facts.Nature: A spirit of Verdelune’s wind, identified in the quest narration
facts.Connection: Ryvyt regards her as a friend and musical inspiration

sources: Quest RP refreshed source · supplied 23 October 2026 · 3,845 messages across the main channel and two accessible threads; posting chronology and narrated continuations remain distinct
body:
Lirael meets the company at Emberwillow Bridge during the search for Selwyn. Her changing translucence, flute and sudden departures belong to the travelers’ experience of Verdelune.

The last direction of a missing traveler

She can point toward the last direction in which the wind passed Selwyn, but says the rest is for the company to discover. She directs them north and fades away. Her words guide a search; they do not establish a fate, a safe route or unlimited knowledge of everything in the forest.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4.

A spirit, without a promise of safety

Fenwick initially calls her a protector. The narrator corrects that interpretation: Lirael is a spirit of Verdelune’s wind, not a physical guardian who has promised to stand between the travelers and danger. The distinction matters when the expedition later faces the river and the Dark Shroud.

Scene references: 1, 2.

Friendship and music

Ryvyt greets her warmly and plays a farewell tune. He says she gave him a flute and that a particular tune can sometimes call her. This records a personal connection and his account of an occasional response, not a universal summoning rule or a guarantee that she will answer.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4.
